# upstream-pr

Send a change to upstream qm without leaking organization-specific context. Use when asked to "upstream this", "open a PR against qm", "contribute this back", or when a fix made in a private fork belongs in core qm.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$upstream-pr`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.

## Contents

- `agents/`
- [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)
